derivation.seed: BIP39 seed of the phrase: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 2048 rounds, salt "mnemonic" (empty passphrase), 64 bytes
derivation.okm: HKDF-SHA-256(ikm = seed, salt = "seedelf-wallet-v1", info = "seedelf-key" || u32_be(account), L = 64)
derivation.sk: int_be(okm) mod r (BLS12-381 scalar field order), 32 bytes big-endian; zero is rejected
derivation.public_value: compressed G1 point G1^sk, the base register's public value

cross_checked: seed, okm and sk against Python hashlib/hmac; public_value against py_ecc; BIP39 layer against the Trezor vector
